name: v7_buyback_reversal_roe_fusion
hypothesis: The original close/open reversal parent is a useful de-correlation component; combine it with buyback yield and a reduced ROE-quality anchor to keep economic strength while avoiding a pure MPpGzqwr near-neighbor.
expression: 0.40 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(common_stock_buyback_payments / cap, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / equity, 126), subindustry)
notes: Parent 3 + payout branch + parent 1. Watch correlation with LLpGdlrm and MPpGzqwr.

name: v7_repurchase_eps_reversal_fusion
hypothesis: Share-count repurchase was near threshold; adding a small EPS-yield parent and close/open reversal may improve Sharpe without becoming a pure EPS or payout clone.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(shares_reacquired_during_period / common_stock_shares_outstanding_count, 252), industry) + 0.30 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(est_eps / close, 126), industry)
notes: Parent 2 + parent 3 + repurchase-count field. EPS weight intentionally capped.

name: v7_customer_authority_reversal_roe
hypothesis: Pure customer authority was weak but positive; combine it with close/open reversal and a small ROE-quality anchor to test whether relationship centrality is useful when stabilized.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(pv13_ustomergraphrank_auth_rank, 60), industry) + 0.35 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / equity, 126), subindustry)
notes: Parent 3 + parent 1 + relationship graph. Avoids operating_income/assets anchor used in 58wp1x1o.

name: v7_news_sentiment_reversal_roe
hypothesis: Earnings-news sentiment had Sharpe but quality-heavy versions were too correlated; add close/open reversal and lower quality weight to seek a more independent signal.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(mean_earnings_evaluation_sentiment, 60), industry) + 0.35 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(operating_income / equity, 126), subindustry)
notes: Parent 3 + parent 1 + Ravenpack earnings sentiment. Correlation gate should reject if it collapses into quality.

name: v7_epsr_reversal_buyback_fusion
hypothesis: Use GAAP EPS estimates instead of the crowded est_eps parent, then mix with close/open reversal and buyback yield to test a lower-correlation analyst/payout hybrid.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(est_epsr / close, 126), industry) + 0.35 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(common_stock_buyback_payments / cap, 126), industry)
notes: Parent 2 variant + parent 3 + payout. Strong EPS-correlation risk, so rely on daily-return gate.
